verdict.rationale: The story applies, since a government IP filing service could publish its account, credential and identity-proofing prerequisites up front. The evidence covers patent, design and trademark procedures, and lists an online filing guide only by title ("Guia de pedido online de marcas e logótipos"). Nothing shows what account, credential (e.g., digital certificate or citizen-card login) or identity-verification steps are required, or that they are stated before the filing flow begins.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
